mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the Federal Reserve's commitment to monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality as investors seek safer assets, reducing equity risk premia and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% in the target horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month moving average of the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting the Fed to hold rates steady while keeping future hikes unlikely, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or UNRATE does not show a sustained decline over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the number of payroll jobs exceeding 200,000 signals a robust labor market, which reduces the risk of a sharp economic slowdown and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or PAYEMS does not exceed 200,000 in the target horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 106.6617 indicates weakening supply-side pressures, which reduces equity risk premia and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or INDPRO does not fall below 106.6617 in the target horizon.
